record.summary: Leaders of ten countries and the EU treat AI safety, innovation and inclusivity as inter-related goals and call for interoperable AI governance frameworks, in line with a risk-based approach, for the safe, secure and trustworthy design, development, deployment and use of AI. They support creating or expanding AI safety institutes, research programmes and supervisory bodies and networks between them, welcome the annexed Seoul Statement of Intent on AI safety science, recognise the particular responsibility of organisations developing frontier AI, note the Frontier AI Safety Commitments and back the operationalisation of the Hiroshima Process Code of Conduct.
record.notes: Agreed at the Leaders' Session of the AI Seoul Summit on 21 May 2024. The summit, co-hosted by the UK and the Republic of Korea on 21 and 22 May 2024, built on the AI Safety Summit at Bletchley Park (INT-03). The Seoul Statement of Intent toward International Cooperation on AI Safety Science (INT-05) is annexed to it. It looks forward to the third gathering, the AI Action Summit in France (INT-01).

title.quote: Seoul Declaration for safe, innovative and inclusive AI by participants attending the Leaders' Session: AI Seoul Summit, 21 May 2024
Seoul Declaration for safe, innovative and inclusive AI by participants attending the Leaders' Session: AI Seoul Summit, 21 May 2024 Published 21 May 2024

status.quote: Seoul Declaration and Statement of Intent toward International Cooperation on AI Safety Science, agreed by world leaders represented at the AI Seoul Summit, 21 May 2024.

issuing_body.quote: We, world leaders representing Australia, Canada, the European Union, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the Republic of Korea, the Republic of Singapore, the United Kingdom, and the United States of America, gathered at the AI Seoul Summit on 21st May 2024
The UK government will co-host the AI Seoul Summit with the Republic of Korea on the 21 and 22 May 2024.

legal_force.quote: affirm our common dedication to fostering international cooperation and dialogue on artificial intelligence

summary.quote: we recognize that AI safety, innovation, and inclusivity are inter-related goals
We recognise the importance of interoperability between AI governance frameworks in line with a risk-based approach
We continue to focus on supporting the operationalisation of the Hiroshima Process International Code of Conduct for Organizations Developing Advanced AI Systems.
We recognize the particular responsibility of organizations developing and deploying frontier AI, and, in this regard, note the Frontier AI Safety Commitments.

We support existing and ongoing efforts of the participants to this Declaration to create or expand AI safety institutes, research programmes and/or other relevant institutions including supervisory bodies

notes.quote: The AI Seoul Summit will build on the legacy of the first AI Safety Summit which was hosted by the UK at Bletchley Park in November 2023
we welcome the Seoul Statement of Intent toward International Cooperation on AI Safety Science, which is annexed to this Declaration
we look forward to our third gathering at the upcoming AI Action Summit to be held in France
